review.name: Luxe Star Rug
independentFindings: The exact-current card and detail pixels read unmistakably as a floor textile rather than a cushion or padded playmat: the broad body stays close to the floor plane and the perimeter presents as a thin bound rug edge.

Material identity is convincing at detail scale through visible woven/pile texture, stitched motif boundaries, modest edge depth, tassels and a grounded contact shadow without upholstered sidewalls or quilting.
Sunny Pop is immediately legible through the warm gold/orange field with peach, cream and aqua accents; the elaborate starburst construction and tassel finish provide appropriate Tier-5 richness.
At catalog-card scale the primary star silhouette, warm palette and asymmetric round/star geometry remain readable; the object does not collapse into an ambiguous blob.
Comparison against the preserved Rugs 1-11 set shows a materially distinct silhouette, motif, palette and construction, with no disqualifying near-duplicate risk.
